newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EDC started as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EDC started as strong buy.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter analyst Mario Epelbaum said Thursday he had started coverage of Venezuela's Electricidad de Caracas SA with a rating of strong buy.
-- He set a price target of $1.75, a 30 percent rise from current levels.

-- "Our upside is based on our expectation that a combination of an increase of EDC's tariffs in real terms and the expected real appreciation of the bolivar will lead to a 40-50 percent increase in operating income from 1997 to 1998," Epelbaum wrote in a report.
-- He added that he expected tariff adjustment for the company to be "around the corner."
-- EDC's shares closed at 649 bolivares Wednesday.
